root_cause.root_cause: Cascading Failure — Database Down → Services Timing Out
root_cause.why: Database failure triggered timeouts in APP, DB, API containers
fix_steps: Check if database container is running (docker ps -a)
Ensure DB port is accessible and not blocked
Add retry logic in application for DB connections
Use depends_on with health checks in docker-compose
